name: Kurano Kazuya
source:
The protagonist and [url=http://vndb.org/c10102]Tomoka's[/url] younger twin brother. Because they're twins they share a room and sleep together in a large double bed. He's on the student council with [url=http://vndb.org/c10100]Izumi[/url]. He and [url=http://vndb.org/c10103]Yae[/url] become the main chefs of the pastry shop

He has the exact same hair and eye color as his twin sister Tomoka.
